mentions.name: RCHIVE Examiner
mentions.description: This free companion app is an ncdu-like disk usage analyzer that shows where hard drive space went and what is hogging it. It is currently available in the macOS App Store, with Windows and Linux versions releasing soon.
mentions.source_excerpt: I also have a companion app RCHIVE Examiner [1], which is a free ncdu-like tool to see where the hell all your hard drive space went, and what's hogging it.
mentions.author: kevinsync
